get.summary: Get all articles which match the specified search criteria. The search criteria are specified in the query parameters.

parameters.name: goodsOwnerId
parameters.description: Goods owner ID.

parameters.name: articleNumber
parameters.description: Article number.

parameters.name: articleSystemIdFrom
parameters.description: Only return articles whose article system ID is greater than or equal to this.

parameters.name: maxArticlesToGet
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return.

parameters.name: stockInfoChangedFrom
parameters.description: Only return articles where the stock balances have changed after this time. NOTE: this value must must be within 24 hours of the current time.

parameters.name: articleDataLastUpdatedFrom
parameters.description: Only return articles where the article data has changed after this time.

parameters.name: onlyArticlesInStock
parameters.description: Only return articles where which are actually in stock (i.e. those articles having numberOfItems > 0).

parameters.name: productCode
parameters.description: Product code.

parameters.name: articleClassIds
parameters.description: Only return articles of these article classes.

parameters.name: onlyArticlesBelowStockLimit
parameters.description: Only return articles whose physical quantity is below the stock limit.

parameters.name: onlyArticlesBelowStockLimitConsideringNumberOfBookedItems
parameters.description: Only return articles which have "physical quantity minus booked quantity" below the stock limit.

parameters.name: isObsolete
parameters.description: Only return articles which have the checkbox "Is obsolete" checked, if parameter is true.
